note: Rules that turn Natural Earth 1:10m (current borders, de facto view) into the political map of 1 January 2000. Applied by scripts/map/build.ts in this order: adm0 owner mapping, admin-1 owner overrides, breakaway clips, start-of-game controllers.

adm1_owner.note: Crimea and Sevastopol were part of Ukraine until 2014.
Dohuk, Erbil and Sulaymaniyah governorates: the area administered by the Kurdistan Regional Government outside Baghdad's control since 1991 (approximation at governorate level).

Districts held by Armenian forces from 1994 until 2020 in addition to the Artsakh polygon: Kalbajar, Lachin (AZE-1735, mislabelled 'Lankaran' in Natural Earth), Qubadli, Zangilan, Jabrayil, Shusha, Khojaly and Khojavend. Agdam and Fuzuli were only partly held and stay with Azerbaijan.

breakaway_clip.note: Natural Earth's Artsakh polygon is the post-2020 area; the surrounding districts held 1994-2020 are added via adm1_owner.

controllers.note: Guantanamo Bay naval base, leased to the United States.
United Front (Northern Alliance) held Badakhshan and parts of Takhar and the Panjshir valley in early 2000 (Taloqan fell in September 2000). Province-level approximation.
LTTE-held Vanni: Mullaitivu and Kilinochchi districts (approximation; parts of Mannar and Vavuniya were also contested).
RCD-held eastern DRC (North Kivu, South Kivu, Maniema) at the start of 2000; province-level approximation.
MLC-held Équateur (northern parts; Mbandaka was government-held). Province-level approximation.
SPLA-held rural south (Western and Eastern Equatoria, Lakes, Northern Bahr el Ghazal, Warrap). Government garrisons held Juba, Wau, Malakal and the oil areas. Province-level approximation.
Second Chechen War: separatists held Grozny and the southern mountains on 1 January 2000 while federal forces held the north; Grozny fell in February 2000. Whole-republic approximation.

UNITA had lost its central-highland strongholds in late 1999 and fought on as a guerrilla force mainly in the east and south-east. Representing it as controlling Moxico and Cuando Cubango is a gameplay approximation.

omitted: FARC's zona de distension (about 42,000 km2 of municipalities in Meta and Caqueta) does not match whole departments; FAR starts without map control until a sub-department split exists.
Kosovo is owned and controlled by YUG as specified, although it was under UNMIK/KFOR administration from June 1999.
Western Sahara is owned by Morocco (the SADR is releasable) as specified; the Polisario-held strip east of the berm is not separated.
